tia: FYI I flipped the new Console toggle to 10% for private-pool routing experiments. saw a weird spike in a single workspace consuming reserved capacity quota 😬
kevin: which workspace? any routing logs?
maria: ws-456. Gateway logs show requests with both X-Workspace-ID and X-VPC-Endpoint headers. The decision tree routed them to the private pool because endpoint matched the VPC mapping. However the quota system still charged the workspace quota instead of the dedicated pool reservation.
tia: ugh — so route went to private pool but billing/quotas didn't follow. could be a telemetry mismatch or an ordering bug between router and quota enforcer.
kevin: can you paste a log sample?
maria: sure — snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T17:05:12Z] req_id=abcd-1234 host=gateway-1 method=POST path=/v1/generate headers={"X-Workspace-ID":"ws-456","X-VPC-Endpoint":"vpce-09d7"} route=private-pool-pool-9 decision=route_private_pool quota_target=workspace:ws-456 billing_tag=ws-456
```
kevin: that `quota_target` looks wrong if we should attribute to pool commit. router decided correctly for affinity but quota enforcer seems to read a different scope. maybe we lost the pool binding in the request context when crossing service boundaries.
sam: this is a good place to add an explicit `routing_scope` field into the request metadata so downstream systems have a canonical source of truth. console toggle should set it when enabling private routing.
tia: agreed. short-term mitigation: roll toggle back to 0% for that workspace, add alert if routing decision != billing target. long-term: make the router attach `routing_scope=pool:dedicated-<id>` and update quota enforcer to prefer that over workspace header.
maria: I can add a quick check in the quota enforcer that validates `X-Routing-Scope` and emits a high-severity metric when it conflicts with `X-Workspace-ID`. will instrument tonight.
kevin: also need a UX tweak in Console — the toggle should warn: "Enabling private pool routing will route traffic into reserved capacity; charges will be applied to pool commitment, not workspace credits". Sam can you draft wording?
sam: yep, will drop a copy in #devex tomorrow, also propose an inline "preview" that simulates routing decision for a workspace before enabling.
tia: sounds good. @deploy-bot can we rollback the toggle for ws-456 to 0% now and unblock the tenant? :pray:
deploy-bot: rollback job queued for toggle=private_pool_percent, target=ws-456, rollout=0% — ETA ~2m.
maria: job completed. routing for ws-456 is back to gateway default (public pools).
tia: follow-ups: (1) instrument `X-Routing-Scope` propagation (maria), (2) console UX copy + preview (sam), (3) quota enforcer pref ordering + detection alert (kevin). I'll create a JIRA and link to this thread.
kevin: add a dashboard tile showing mismatch rate (routing decisions vs billing attribution) — we should see baseline near 0. :eyes:
sam: will draft the console copy and the preview mock, pinging design.
ria (ops): heads-up from support — tenant reached out about an unexpected burst charge, they're paused now. forwarding the ticket.
tia: thanks, team. when we have the dashboard alert we'll set an automated page if mismatch > 1% for 5m. :+1:
